response.rationale: These are different concepts. A is a Session: a scheduled rink slot that bookings are grouped by, as shown in InMemoryBookingRepository (node 01a5b91a0794e2b2, src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts), "listBySession(sessionId: string): Booking[] {". B is a Session Report: a summary built over a date range, as shown in RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, src/business/rinkService.ts), "getReport(q: { from?: unknown; to?: unknown; weekStart?: unknown }): Report {". A report may summarise sessions, but it is a separate output and not the session itself. The two names share the word "session", but they refer to different real-world things.
